_what: The rules of a document edited as a sequence of operations (src/workspace/document-operations.mjs), shared by the page and the person's store (src/native-workspace-records.mjs). schema_version is what this build reads and writes: a stored document whose schema_version is newer is refused, never opened and rewritten by an older build. format_versions names each block text model: a block kept as one whole text (0) and a block kept as an id-addressed character sequence (1) live in the same document; a whole-text block becomes a sequence on the first text operation that touches it. limits bound every batch, document, undo stack (edits closer together than undo_group_ms are one undo step) and kept operation log. label_prefix is the start of the saved-record label one document's operations are kept under.
